name: tf2sos
comment: Sig sos=tf2sos(b,a): transfer function -> SOS. Equal-degree b=[1 1 1],a=[1 0.5 0.25] -> single biquad row [1 1 1 1 0.5 0.25]. Degree-deficient b=[1 0.5] (3 poles) must REPRODUCE the original numerator: sos2tf(tf2sos(...)) = b2=[1 0.5 0 0] (surplus zeros LEFT-aligned at infinity, NOT pushed to origin like zp2sos) with a2=[1 -0.3 0.02 0.001].
